preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None (empty tree) or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child])
preconditions.description: Every node's value (candies) must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 10^4, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or isinstance(node.left, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child])
preconditions.description: Every node's left child must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or isinstance(node.right, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child])
preconditions.description: Every node's right child must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(abs(node.val - 1) for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child]) // 2
postconditions.description: The returned value is exactly half the sum of absolute differences between each node's candy count and 1, representing the minimal moves required to distribute exactly one candy per node.
